newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday as Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $14 from $13.875 a day earlier while Banque Audi held steady at $19.125.
Solidere shares were steady. A shares traded at Thursday's $10.25 and B shares were unchanged at $10.75. Total turnover in the company's shares was 88,038 shares from 85,525.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.45 percent to 120.10 while the BLOM stock index rose 0.01 percent to 902.87 and the LISPI rose 0.09 percent to 85.04.
Ciments Libanais held steady at $1.1875 on turnover of 100 shares.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 103,859 for a value of $1,188,365 against 139,940 shares for a value of $1,327,102 on Thursday.
